acceptances.commentBody:
/sdlc accept sha256:84bff5d0817cafec6569b394b99eb92cc8b60e98b450bea9484992bcf11bc0d4
Final acceptance approved for the verified image from merged source 06e9fe31d5c00bb75a2438e49af00ea4fac8b134, publication run38311999223 attempt2, following the assistant-run evidence in comment6133700328. The merged source passed all47 tests. Exact-image HTTP checks established DB-independent liveness, healthy/invalid/repaired readiness, GET/HEAD/no-store/method/input contracts, same-process query recovery and empty-table readiness without reseeding. A populated isolated volume survived restart and exclusive repair handover with all4 original records and timestamps preserved. Real browser submissions verified new-ticket unassigned creation,12 ownership checks across4 statuses, valid status changes, invalid creation/owner/status rejection, unchanged-owner timestamp preservation and7 filter checks. Repeated probes preserved all5 records after intentional new-ticket edits. All7 task containers and3 owned volumes were removed; shared resources were not changed. Accept this bounded database-read readiness increment, not write availability per probe, latency guarantees, production certification or completion of broader reliability work. Baseline dependency advisories and agreed deferred risks remain outstanding.
